description:
List counter screens

Lists every Presence counter screen of your account with its full state: pairing, whether it is online, its last self test, opening hours and limits, minutes used today and a running conversation. Use it to get a screen `id` for `update_presence_device`, `send_presence_command` and the other screen tools, or to check its settings. For only the conversations running now use `list_presence_live`, for usage over several days `get_presence_analytics`, for how many screens your plan pays for `get_presence_allowance`. Read only.
name: list_presence_devices
